recipes.name: Simple Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: In a food processor, blend the oatmeal into a flour. Alternatively, use store-bought oatmeal flour.
Combine all the pancake ingredients in a large bowl.
Preheat a large pan over medium-high heat with oil. When hot, spoon about ¼ cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake. Cook for about 2 minutes.
When the bottom becomes golden, flip and cook for another 2 minutes, or until lightly golden.
For a more balanced breakfast, enjoy these pancakes with some creamy nut butter drizzled overtop, fresh fruit, and creamy plant-based yogurt.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. If you prefer a distinct coconut taste, use unrefined coconut oil instead.

Storage Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days. Frozen, these can last up to two months. Freeze with pieces of parchment separating the pancakes to prevent them from sticking together.
